Method of Attack: Modifies the Windows Discord client JavaScript files to steal user tokens and saved credit card information
Steals Discord user tokens by copying browser databases and scanning for tokens
Sends stolen tokens to attacker's Discord channel
Spreads malware via Discord DMs to victim's friends
Attempts to steal saved payment information via Discord API
Becomes persistent by modifying discord_voice\index.js file
Impacted Systems: Browsers: Chrome, Discord, Opera, Brave, Yandex Browser, Vivaldi, Chromium
Attack Vector: Malware distributed via Discord direct messages promoting fake Discord Nitro hack
Indicators of Compromise: %AppData%\Discord\0.0.306\modules\discord_voice\index.js file modified with appended malicious code
Malicious Discord DMs containing links to malware disguised as Discord Nitro hack
